prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached NR-22-v3 approved-direction city map with ONLY TWO small changes to EXISTING GROUND VEGETATION. Return ONE image.
1. Make ground-level foliage and grass a LITTLE DEEPER GREEN: gently deepen natural leaf/grass greens, reducing pale yellow-green tendency. Subtle darker natural green, retaining sunlit leaves and soft shadows. Not dark forest paint, not teal/blue, not global saturation or contrast. Do not recolor buildings, pavement, roads, roofs, canals, sky or any nonplant material.
2. Reduce ground PLANTING DENSITY by ABOUT10% RELATIVE TO THIS EXACT INPUT. Retain roughly90% of existing planted density. Thin a small selection of crowded street trees, shrubs and little planted patches distributed across the district; improve breathing room. Do not reduce greenery by10percentage points of whole map area. Preserve the existing park, mature landmark trees, coherent canopy sizes, riverbank planting purpose, entry gardens, planting-bed edges and street identity; do not clear major green areas or shrink every tree. Where a small plant is removed, reveal naturally matching existing ground/planting soil or pavement, with no new building or road.
STRICT INVARIANTS: preserve this exact whole-region composition, ALL building identities/shapes/heights/roof materials/windows/entrances, museum, library, office, exhibition hall, science dome, mall, theater, playground, their positions, road network/widths/junctions, source waterways, original footprints, camera62.5deg/45deg, scale, boundary, native framing, exterior transparency and nonvegetation palette/light. Approximate50percent residential planning is unchanged. NO roof or terrace plants. Do not redesign architecture, rearrange blocks, insert or remove facilities, change global sunlight, add yellow/blue tint or lit windows. This input is an EDIT TARGET whose approved architecture must be kept, not a new reference for redesigning the city. Native whole-region RGBA with preserved alpha; one candidate only.

references.role: specific user-approved-direction image as EDIT TARGET, not a new style authority

editRequest.baseline: NR-22-v3;relative density not minus10percentage points of whole image

observed: Ground greens appear somewhat deeper and planted areas less crowded, but exact10percent not measured.
Architecture and major facilities appear broadly retained; not claiming pixel-identical invariants.
